summary: validate-modules codes for documented-but-nonexistent options, bad option version_added, invalid parameter names and elements, implied type mismatches, and alias problems.

answer_card.title: validate-modules codes (parameters)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `nonexistent-parameter-documented`: documented option the module doesn't accept
- `option-incorrect-version-added` / `option-invalid-version-added`
- `parameter-invalid`: not a valid Python identifier
- `parameter-invalid-elements`: `elements` only with `type: list`
- `implied-parameter-type-mismatch`: spec implies `str` but docs say otherwise
- `parameter-type-not-in-doc`: spec has type, docs don't
- `parameter-alias-repeated`, `parameter-alias-self`, `parameter-documented-multiple-times`
